recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. Do not narrow MedicationRequest.informationSource back to 0..1 or remove Group as part of FHIR-19640; those are later decisions. issue_request: FHIR-19640 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to add MedicationRequest.informationSource back as a standalone element for the source of information when different from the requester. It also replaced the prior reported[x] reference choice with a standalone reporting boolean and requested default-false semantics when the reporting flag is missing.
initial_application: Commit cdb9b154325715da80c5913ec7939955b7d52105, merged by ec284380a4c273eeee93dc77e0ead3366dddec01, applied the original change to the then-authoritative MedicationRequest spreadsheet: reported[x] boolean|Reference became a boolean reported element, and MedicationRequest.informationSource was added as 0..1 Reference(Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, RelatedPerson, Organization) with the requested source/reporter wording.
additional_context: The active current source is source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml. Later Published issue FHIR-35847 changed MedicationRequest.informationSource to 0..*. Later Applied issue FHIR-41408 added Group as a target profile. Later Applied issue FHIR-47855 clarified that informationSource identifies the reporter of the MedicationRequest rather than the original requester. Current source also reflects the later FHIR-49863 rename from reported to isRecordOfRequest, while the default-false/missing-value semantics are already represented by the FHIR-34195 reconciliation on the combined branch.
